hero.title: Premium Automotive Excellence
hero.subtitle: ABR Deluxe Auto specializes in new & pre-owned vehicles, luxury rentals, and global import solutions. Trusted partner for luxury, performance, and reliability.

about.title: ABR Deluxe Auto – Company Profile
about.p1: ABR Deluxe Auto is a specialized automotive company dedicated to the trade of new and pre-owned vehicles, as well as offering premium car rental services. Since our establishment, we have positioned ourselves as a trusted partner in the automotive market by providing clients with high-quality vehicles that combine luxury, performance, and reliability.
about.p2: We source and import a wide variety of automobiles directly from some of the world’s most reputable automotive markets, including China, Dubai, Qatar, and Europe. This diverse network allows us to supply an extensive range of vehicles that meet the different needs of our customers—whether for personal use, business, or specialized fleets.
about.p3: Our operations are not limited to sales and rentals; we are also committed to expanding our geographical presence across regional and international markets. Through strategic sourcing and strong supplier relationships, ABR Deluxe Auto aims to build a sustainable and self-sufficient automotive ecosystem that ensures continuous availability of vehicles at competitive prices.
about.p4: With a customer-centric approach, we focus on delivering not only cars but also trust, convenience, and value. Our goal is to be recognized as a leading automotive provider that consistently exceeds expectations, setting new standards in the buying, selling, and rental of vehicles.
about.p5: At ABR Deluxe Auto, we don’t just sell cars — we deliver driving experiences.
about.visionText: To become a leading and trusted automotive company in the region and beyond, recognized for innovation, reliability, and excellence.
about.missionText: To deliver a wide range of new and pre-owned vehicles with premium rental solutions, serving customers with integrity and professionalism.

services.title: Our Premium Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive automotive solutions tailored to your needs
services.salesText: Discover a wide range of brand-new and certified pre-owned vehicles, carefully sourced from China, Dubai, Qatar, and Europe. Whether you seek elegance, performance, or practicality — we have the perfect match for you.
services.rentalsText: Drive in style with our short-term and long-term rental options. From economy cars to luxury SUVs and high-performance models, our fleet is designed to offer comfort, flexibility, and prestige.
services.importText: We simplify the process of bringing cars from the world’s top automotive markets. With our global sourcing network, we handle logistics, customs, and registration — so you can enjoy your car hassle-free.
services.fleetText: Empower your business with customized fleet management solutions. We provide reliable, cost-effective vehicles and long-term contracts tailored to meet your corporate needs.
services.supportText: Our relationship doesn’t end with the sale. We provide after-sales guidance, documentation support, and dedicated customer service, ensuring peace of mind with every drive
